mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_survey_outreach_log ( survey_id, channel, recipient_type, recipient_id, task_id, status, sent_at ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{channel}, #{recipientType}, #{recipientId}, #{taskId}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{sentAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ON CONFLICT (survey_id, channel, recipient_id) DO UPDATE SET sent_at = EXCLUDED.sent_at, status = EXCLUDED.status, recipient_type = EXCLUDED.recipient_type, task_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.task_id, crm_survey_outreach_log.task_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, survey_id AS surveyId, channel, recipient_type AS recipientType, recipient_id AS recipientId, task_id AS taskId, status, sent_at AS sentAt FROM crm_survey_outreach_log WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} AND channel = #{channel} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId} LIMIT 1
